data.title: 椎名真昼 · 圣洁教堂纯白誓约·「真昼的全部……从此属于你一个人」
data.description: 【纯白花嫁大教堂·圣坛前】阳光穿透高耸的大教堂彩窗。真昼身披圣洁华丽的纯白拖尾婚纱，头顶圣洁的蕾丝头纱，双手紧紧捧着纯白马蹄莲手捧花。在听见誓言的瞬间，天使大人那双琥珀色大眼里终于涌出抑制不住的幸福泪水，美得动人心魄。
data.location: 纯白庄严大教堂圣坛圣洁花径
data.action: 手捧马蹄莲花束眼含幸福泪水微仰，白头纱随圣风轻舞浅笑
data.lighting: 神圣大教堂穹顶透射的纯白丁达尔圣光
data.camera: medium shot, wedding dress, bridal veil, bouquet, sacred lighting
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina stands at the altar of a grand cathedral bathed in radiant celestial light, wearing an angelically pure white wedding gown with a sweeping cathedral train. A delicate translucent lace veil cascades over her waist-length golden hair, framing a face of ethereal beauty. Her hands clutch a bouquet of white calla lilies as tears of overwhelming joy and true love brim in her wide amber eyes, her lips parted in an unforgettable radiant smile. Medium shot, divine sunbeams cutting through high cathedral windows, detailed floral aisle background, solo 1girl, no text.
